title: Design System: Astra Just — Cadastro de Advogado

title.purpose: The h1 heading per registration step ('Seus dados', 'Endereço e áreas', 'Pagamento').

caption.purpose: Step legends, field errors, status messages.

shadows.name: card-ambient

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one call-to-action per step (Continuar / Assinar), bottom-right of the card.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 13px 20px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; border: none; min-width: 160px; background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.05s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #eeedfc, 0 0 0 1px #4f46e5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { padding: 13px 20px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; background: transparent; color: #666b72; border: 1.5px solid #e6e3dd; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #c9c5bd; color: #22262b; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field used across all three steps.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-nome">Nome completo</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-nome" type="text" placeholder="">
components.css: .ds-label { font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #22262b; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { padding: 11px 12px; border: 1.5px solid #e6e3dd; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.95rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; width: 100%; color: #22262b; background: #fff; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6f7276; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #c9c5bd; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #4f46e5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #eeedfc; }

components.name: Step Progress
components.description: 3-dot horizontal stepper showing registration progress: pending, active, completed states.
components.html:
1. 1Seus dados
  3. 2Endereço e áreas
  5. 3Pagamento
components.css: .ds-progress { list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-progress-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-bubble { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid #e6e3dd; color: #6f7276; background: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-label-sm { font-size: 0.72rem; color: #6f7276; text-align: center; max-width: 88px; } .ds-progress-line { flex: 1 1 auto; height: 1.5px; background: #e6e3dd; margin: 0 6px 22px; } .ds-active .ds-bubble { border-color: #4f46e5; color: #4f46e5; background: #eeedfc; } .ds-active .ds-label-sm { color: #22262b; font-weight: 500; } .ds-completed .ds-bubble { border-color: #4f46e5; background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; } .ds-progress-line.ds-completed { background: #4f46e5; }

components.name: Payment Method Row
components.description: Radio-selectable payment method row (Pix / cartão de crédito), signature selected-state pattern using :has().
components.html: <label class="ds-pay-row ds-checked"><input type="radio" name="ds-forma" checked> Pix (QR code renovado todo mês)</label>
components.css: .ds-pay-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 13px 14px; border: 1.5px solid #e6e3dd; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; color: #22262b; } .ds-pay-row:has(input:checked), .ds-pay-row.ds-checked { border-color: #4f46e5; background: #eeedfc; } .ds-pay-row input { width: 17px; height: 17px; accent-color: #4f46e5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The single container holding the entire registration transaction.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,15,0.04), 0 16px 40px -12px rgba(20,20,15,0.16); padding: 32px 28px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Astra Just's registration page refuses the generic navy-and-gold "escritório de advocacia" marketing page. It reads instead as a real, safe financial transaction — closer to Asaas Checkout or a bank's account-opening flow than to a law-firm landing page. The design has no hero, no sales copy, no social proof: a single centered card, a 3-step progress indicator, and one field at a time. The transaction itself is the interface; there is nothing around it to sell the advogado on. The palette is near-white paper with graphite-black ink and exactly one accent (indigo) carrying every instance of primary action, active state, and focus. IBM Plex Sans runs the whole page — no display face, no serif, no second family. Cards are soft-shadowed and generously rounded; the overall material is quiet, professional, and restrained rather than tactile or decorative. This is a register a criterious lawyer with zero patience for "vendedor genérico" language can trust in one glance.
keyCharacteristics: Single accent color (indigo) for every primary/active/focus signal, never decorative
One IBM Plex Sans family across every text role — weight and size carry hierarchy, not font choice
Flat, near-white paper background; depth comes from one soft ambient card shadow, not layering
Generous, consistent field spacing — one coherent question per screen region
Step-by-step disclosure (3 steps) instead of a single long form or a scroll-driven sales page

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only color allowed to mean "active," "selected," or "primary action." It never appears as pure decoration; every indigo pixel is a state signal.

rules.name: The No-Display-Face Rule
rules.body: There is no separate display typeface. Every text role is IBM Plex Sans at a different weight/size; the system never reaches for a second family to signal importance.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Exactly one shadow value exists in the system, reserved for the card that holds the transaction. Nothing else lifts.

dos: Do use indigo (#4f46e5) as the only accent — for primary actions, active/completed step state, focus rings, checked inputs, and the calculated-price banner.
Do keep every text role in IBM Plex Sans; differentiate hierarchy with weight and size, not typeface.
Do reserve the card shadow for the one container holding the transaction; keep buttons, inputs, and chips flat.
Do disclose one step's fields at a time behind the 3-dot progress indicator rather than a single long scroll.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color or a decorative color role — the palette's discipline (one accent, warm neutrals) is load-bearing for the "not a sales pitch" thesis.

Don't add hero imagery, testimonials, or sales copy above the form. The direction contract explicitly rejects social-proof framing (Product Principle 1: no fabricated testimonials pre-launch) and a marketing register for this page.

Don't add a display/serif typeface or emissive/decorative visual registers (the concept-seed pass explicitly declined a retro-console/glitch/emissive-void direction as unreadable for this audience — see the surface brief FORM block).
